summary_text: Investigated C-1042 billing dispute (SUP-5602) by pulling account, invoices, payments, credits, subscription events, all related tickets (SUP-5201, 5390, 5549, 5601, 5602), and billing policies (proration, credits, authorizations, add_ons, refunds). Reconciled findings: (1) The "duplicate charge" on 9/14 was actually one captured payment (TX-9001, $149) and one released, uncaptured authorization (TX-9002) per POL-B-AUTH—not a real duplicate; SUP-5601's promised $149 refund was an erroneous overcommitment that also violated POL-B-REF (agents can't promise refunds pre-review). (2) The $30 Deep Time Analytics add-on charge is legitimate per POL-B-ADD (added by admin U-2), though owner may be unaware. (3) The $59.60 July 2 proration charge (INV-2607P) is correctly calculated per POL-B-PRO. (4) CR-778 ($19.60 proration credit) remains unapplied, is over 30 days old, and owner was never notified—violating POL-B-CRD; this is a genuine billing error. Progress recorded via record_progress. Next step: draft final report distinguishing actual vs apparent errors and listing actions requiring human authorization
